youtube.title: Why Bottle Caps Have Exactly 21 Teeth 🍺 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The crown cap was patented by William Painter in 1892 to seal fizzy drinks. Its pleated edge is crimped around the lip of the glass bottle, pressing a soft liner tight against the rim. The teeth grip the glass and hold in the pressure of the carbonated drink; 21 teeth became the standard for bottle caps.
